_comment: Editable rules mapping Alpaca document titles to filename summaries. Checked in order: tax (unused, tax forms are not collected yet), then insurance (unused), then statement. alpaca_site.py titles each document by the type Alpaca's list gives it: account_statement is 'Brokerage Statement', crypto_account_statement 'Crypto Statement' and trade_confirmation 'Trade Confirmation'. The crypto rule comes first so a crypto statement and a brokerage statement of one month keep names of their own.
